column_description: TEXT. Unique identifier for each environmental reading. PK.
TIMESTAMP. Timestamp of when the environmental reading was taken. Not NULL. Example: 2024-08-06T08:38:48.
TEXT. Reference to the showcase. FK to Showcases.caseID.
BIGINT. Temperature reading in Celsius. **NULL means no temperature data available.**. Example: 21.73.
REAL. Temperature variation over 24 hours. **NULL means no temperature variation recorded.**. Example: 0.85.
BIGINT. Relative humidity variation. **NULL means no humidity variation recorded.**. Example: 2.54.
REAL. Air pressure reading. **NULL means no air pressure data available.**. Example: 1020.0.
